string.text: Who are you?
They say they found you among the corpses from the Death Truck. So why do you need Gunslinger?
Are you Gunslinger?
Did you not share something with Gunslinger? There are rumors that Gunslinger wiped out your entire group. And you really don't remember which group you belonged to?
And which group do you belong to?
We're having a great, informative conversation, aren't we! Nothing but questions...
Did you also lose your memory?
Alright, buddy, don't take it to heart, I think we'll meet again. Though the Zone is vast, the stalker's path always leads to artifacts.
You still haven't told me your name, who should I thank for the dog?
Thank the Zone, and I'm called Lone Wolf. Well, goodbye! Oh, and don't go to the farm: there's a poltergeist hiding in the ruins there and a ton of rats!
Go ahead and say it.
I'm listening.
How are you, stalker?
What do you want?
I told you, even though the Zone is vast, we'll meet again! I'm the Lone Wolf, remember me?
I remember.
Yes, much has changed since our last meeting, considering your first words now were "I remember." Before, you only had questions on your tongue... Have you already met Rat, the local bartender?
I've had enough of his lackeys guarding the entrance. And I still have questions, I've just learned to keep my mouth shut.
Well, you must understand, in these conditions...
I don't owe anyone anything. And anyway, I... really want to sleep.
Oh, now I recognize you! Come on, I'll show you the local apartments, without a guide, you won't find them here.
Let's go then.
Alright, let's go.
Come in...

Here we go - the Bar! See that guy sitting over there? That's Buival. Rumor has it he made it further north than just about anyone else. Even caught sight of the power station's outline! \n \nAnd that one over there is Mope - a bit touched in the head, but he somehow walked away from a hit by the Brain Scorcher's radiation. What that thing usually leaves behind doesn't even qualify as a person anymore. But Mope? Cool as a cucumber - just a few loose screws.
...RD-100, there are several of them around here, right?
Wow, someone else complained about memory!

With a relatively empty head, new information is much easier to digest. Even if some of the words look like mysterious abbreviations, and some of them are perceived as meaningless symbols. By the way, maybe you can tell me what's outside the Zone?
And you don't know?
Why would I ask then?
Well, somewhere there's a city... I don't remember exactly what it's called. The soldiers come from there, or rather, they used to.
It seems like everyone here has some sort of selectively specific memory.
What do you mean?
Oh, it's just something that came to mind... Better tell me, do you know Gunslinger?
Yes. And by the way, you remind me of him somehow.
And the Journalist?
Darn, here comes the owner towards us...
I have a business proposal for you.
I don't like discussing business on an empty stomach.
Okay, I'll wait for you, let's say, in an hour, is that alright with you?
Hmm... Rat...

You shouldn't treat him like that. He's Rat 5, but unlike the previous ones, he's been in this place for more than half a year. And as you can see, there are plenty of people who want his place. But what's more, he's organized an uninterrupted supply of food and ammunition--
Alright, let's check how reliable these deliveries are and what kind of products are there. Oh, by the way, where do the deliveries come from?
Why does it matter?
Well, in principle... Is there any alcohol in them?
Of course... I think we can drink it.

There's no way I had nothing to do with Gunslinger. A lot of people knew him, even Rat was afraid of him. But I, strangely enough, no one remembers me. But this can't be possible - the death trucks come from the very depths of the Zone - so I was there, and to go there unnoticed... Something's wrong! I couldn't have come from the north. Maybe I did, maybe I didn't. Tell me, Wolf, do you like living in the Zone?
What?
Did I formulate my question unclearly?
Well, you see, of course, our life here, on the one hand, is somewhat... peculiar, and on the other hand... monotonous, but there are two nuances...
Which ones?
Firstly, it's unknown what's happening in other places... And secondly, there's also this thing... "Black Monolith". Traders know something about it, try asking them...
Alright, I need to talk to Rat.
Leave us two alone.
Do I have to repeat myself?
That's an interesting security detail you got there.

They think, I don't know, that they've been assigned to me by the military... You're probably wondering why he's opening up. Uh, I don't read minds. Not really. Alright, files. Alright. Okay, it talks about some kind of psychotropic installations that are located in the zone in the north... Apparently, they're an obstacle. It also says that the scientist base on Yantar was supplying equipment for these antennas.
You know the legend of the Black Monolith?
Well, you could say I know almost nothing. I don't believe it.
No one needs you to believe. I don't. Almost. Then what do you need?
Well done, clever boy. I do need you.
I don't need you.
Don't be rude.
Alright. (chuckles) I'll consider myself a good listener... for now.

That's better. So, uh, about the Black Monolith. There are a number of once-secret laboratories in the Zone. When they were built and for what purpose, of course, no one is interested. Some of them, while they were functioning, were engaged in mutations, the soil was fertile. Once at the energy heart of the Zone, a nuclear power plant, there was an accident, an explosion of radioactive substances contaminated a fairly large area. A sarcophagus was erected, and the bulk of radioactive substances were buried under a multi-meter thick concrete. And within a radius of 30 kilometers around the territory became the Zone. But there were other laboratories on the territory of the Zone, which apparently appeared long before the catastrophe. Moreover, someone somewhere found separate documents that could suggest that the accident was the result of some mysterious experiments. Where and who saw such documents was not known. But the rumors were persistent. Rumors could not be gagged like poor Hoplite, rumors could not be taken out of circulation by a successful military operation or by groups like Duty, who carefully collected and destroyed paper information... Lately, it's been simply out of inertia. And one such rumor was the legend of the Black Monolith. In one of the halls of the abandoned Sarcophagus, there was supposedly a device that fulfilled wishes. Materialized the most underlying desires. This tale even had an almost scientific basis. They say that an obscure device, originally associated with some esoteric-extrasensory things, under the influence of unknown processes occurring in the sarcophagus, acquired completely new properties associated with the transformation of time into space... or maybe vice versa.
The device itself may have existed and even functioned somehow, but what does it have to do with wishes? This is nonsense! What do you want me to do? You want me to go and make a wish for you?

I could play hide-and-seek with you, but I don't have a wish. I mean play hide-and-seek, and I have plenty of wishes for the monolith. What I've heard about you forces me to play with open cards. There are three devices on the path to the monolith, some kind of RDs. Stalkers say they make your brain boil.
You think my brain is more fireproof?
Don't be sarcastic. If it's true that you're thrice-born, then you've been on the other side of the barrier that the RDs form.
Even if I was there, I don't remember anything about it. But am I the only one who's been there? There's Gobber.
Maybe there were others. They say Gunslinger was there, but nobody's seen him for a long time.
Did you send him to the power plant?
I just told him how to try to do it.
How?

Well, I'd start by going to one of the scientists' camps. You know, at least in the lakes area. They're-- Hold on, I got a visitor. Shit, you better go. It's in your best interest not to meet this man. Keep in mind, there's a lot of psi activity at the lake. If you don't want your brains fried, stay away from the central complex. Oh, by the way, since you're going to Yantar. Here you go -- artifact crossbreeder. You can think of it as a reward for the lab documents. Just be warned, there are no recipes in the device's memory. You can ask the scientists if you're going there. The road to Yantar is right here on the bar grounds. It's a former freeway. As you leave the bar, go straight southwest on the road, that's how you'll get to the lake. Oh, wait. I need time to arrange a meeting between you and the Professor, and there's still a lot of psi activity on the lake. So go to Quiet Hills and scout out the military base area there. I'm interested in what's going on there in general. After that, you can move on to Yantar. That's it, go.
Hello, Rat, trying to do your business behind my back?
Hello, Major. I was acting solely on your instructions.
Were you following me?
Well, not only Rat has wide capabilities.
Who are you working for?
For no one. I'm not called the Lone Wolf for nothing. I just wanted to warn you not to trust Rat.
And should I trust you?
It's up to you. Rat will sell you out and exploit you, but first, he'll use you.
And you?
I would like to help you.
And why?
For some reason, I feel like you could change something in our world.
Before changing anything, it would be good to understand what's really going on around. And it seems like not long ago everything was fine with you.

A lot of stalkers have tried to get past RD installations. Some say they did. But no one's seen them since. You're the first, not counting zombies, to ride in the trucks of death with almost no visible damage. Speaking of zombies, there are a few in the neighborhood, looking for you.
Let them search! They're already deprived enough, let them enjoy this at least.

Many will try to fall on your tail as you move towards the power plant, Rat in particular. The black monolith is something akin to oil and diamonds: where it is, there is greed, betrayal and death. People are not even frightened by what they say: as if it fulfills only the underlying, most cherished dreams. And can't we, living in such conditions, be suspected, for example, of an underlying desire... self-destruction?
Well, I think it's time for me to go. Farewell, Lone Wolf.
Take my rifle, it saved your life once already. Maybe it won't be the last time!
